document.title: Triangular helpers without type-preserving conversion
document.summary: upper_triangular and lower_triangular now use triu and tril, so Adjoint Cholesky factors on Julia 1.13 no longer raise a MethodError.

conclusion.summary: No blocker found in the source-checked scope; runtime behavior was not run.

review.title: Fix triangular helpers for adjoint Cholesky factors on Julia 1.13
review.head: f4f30f5b0b35ca4069f349804fe7624caa2868f3

sources.label: Head: vec_to_triu1 and vec_to_triu use upper_triangular
Head: ReverseDiff overrides for the helpers

blocks.text:
Bijectors.jl provides bijections between constrained and unconstrained spaces. CorrBijector and VecCorrBijector map correlation matrices using a Cholesky factor.

On Julia 1.13 the upper factor of a Cholesky object stored as the lower triangle is UpperTriangular(C.factors'), so its parent is an Adjoint. The old upper_triangular tried to convert that matrix back to an Adjoint and threw a MethodError. Mooncake forward mode always stores the lower triangle, so correlation bijectors fail under it. This PR changes the two helpers to triu and tril.
Affected users: Julia 1.13 users of CorrBijector, VecCorrBijector or cholesky_upper, mostly with Mooncake. The helpers are internal functions, not documented API.

blocks.title: Result on Julia 1.13 (from the PR description)
blocks.before: MethodError: the Adjoint parent cannot be produced by convert(typeof(A), UpperTriangular(A)).
blocks.after: A Matrix with the upper triangle of the factor. The new test expects it to equal Matrix(CL.U).

blocks.text: This comparison comes from the PR description and source reading. It was not run here.

blocks.title: Benefits and costs
rows: tril and triu return a plain Matrix for any AbstractMatrix input, including an Adjoint. This removes the failing conversion.
The result type is no longer typeof(A). For a Matrix input nothing changes. For other input types the output may differ. The callers read here pass Matrix values.
ReverseDiff overrides still intercept TrackedMatrix. Other backends now differentiate through tril and triu instead of convert and LowerTriangular. This was not checked.

blocks.title: Runtime behavior is not reproduced
blocks.text: The MethodError and the fix rest on the PR description and on source reading. No Julia 1.13 run was done in this review, per the source-only rule.

blocks.title: The regression test passes trivially before Julia 1.13
blocks.text: On earlier Julia versions parent(CL.U) is already a Matrix, so the test exercises the old code path without failing. It guards the bug only on 1.13 and later. The test also calls the helpers directly and does not call cholesky_upper or cholesky_lower on a lower-stored factor. A direct call of cholesky_upper with a Hermitian lower input would cover the reported path. This is a nonblocking suggestion.

blocks.title: AD through tril and triu with Mooncake and others
blocks.text: The failure was reported under Mooncake forward mode. After the change those backends differentiate tril and triu. The PR says the Mooncake integration cases fail on 1.13 in CI. Does CI on this head show those cases passing? The check was not made here.

blocks.title: Output type of the helpers
blocks.text: Dropping typeof(A) changes the output type for inputs that are not Matrix. Only Matrix inputs were found at the callers read here, so no change is expected. A note in the comment above the helpers would record that the result is a Matrix.
